BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BHMCT   SEMESTER: VIII
BRANCH: HMCT   SESSION: SP/2020

SUBJECT: HM8043 HOTEL LAW

TIME: 1.5 HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. . The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
6. Tables/Data hand book/Graph paper etc. to be supplied to the candidates in the examination hall.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Describe law in brief. [2]
 (b) What do you understand by license and permits? [3]


Q2 (a) Write at least five tourist establishments approved by ministry of tourism. [2]
 (b) How important guest relations is in a star hotel? Describe [3]


Q3 (a) What is Indian contract act? Explain [2]
 (b) Explain types of law. [3]


Q4 (a) Describe in brief types of contract. [2]
 (b) Explain disclaimers of warranty. [3]


Q5 (a) What is food legislation? [2]
 (b) Why food laws came into existence? Explain [3]


Q6 (a) What is permitted hours in liquor business? [2]
 (b) What is occasional license and how it is different from seasonal license? [3]
